info.name: VibeGrid Platform API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API collection for VibeGrid Clean Architecture Microservices platform.

**Authentication Flow:**
1. Select Environment (Local or Production).
2. Run `01. Authentication & Identity -> Login (User or Admin)`.
3. The test script automatically extracts `access_token` from Set-Cookie / body and sets `{{jwt_token}}`.
4. All subsequent requests automatically inherit Bearer token & Cookie headers.

**Dynamic Variable Chaining:** Post IDs, Poll IDs, Conversation IDs, and Guild Slugs are auto-captured.
